description: Source code for the Store module controller class within the OpenCart admin extension namespace. It manages the display and saving of store configuration options in the admin panel.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing the store extension module in the OpenCart admin panel, extending the base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the store configuration page in the admin panel. Loads language files, sets the page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to save store module settings. Checks permissions, updates settings, and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.
